=== jal to a label compresses to c.jal on RV32
        jal     target
        nop
target:
        ret

=== a jal too far for c.jal
        jal     target
        .space  3000
target:
        ret

=== branch relaxation
        beqz    a0, out
        .space  400
out:
        ret

=== call and la
        call    target
        la      a0, target
target:
        ret

=== norvc
        .option norvc
        mv      a0, a1
        ret
